says: Opus builds alone; Opus repairs in the same session

findings: src/game.js fly() checks only shell positions at tick boundaries, so a shot from (0, 0) heading 0 passes through a tank at (5.225, 1.449) without damaging it; collision detection must cover the distance travelled between ticks.

src/game.js fly() excludes exact tank contact with its strict '<' comparison: firing from (0,0) at heading 0 past a computer at (5.225,1.45) leaves its health at 100 and the shell alive, although their radii touch and the spec requires damage and shell removal.
src/game.js fly() checks tanks in object order rather than impact order, so a shell crossing both tanks during one tick can damage the farther player instead of the nearer computer.
src/game.js bounce() checks only shell endpoints, allowing a shell moving from (-9.258, 4.919) to (-9.081, 4.742) to cross within 0.24 units of an inner-wall corner without its required bounce.
src/view.js fit() moves the entire arena beyond the camera's fixed 200-unit far plane at a 300×1000 browser size, making the arena and both tanks disappear.
